title: Peek PowerToys interfere with Windows Explorer file selection highlight (“Show in folder” / /select behavior broken)

status.label: Needs focused investigation
status.detail: With Peek enabled, Explorer reportedly opens the right folder but loses the selected file after Show in folder or Open file location.

next_action.label: Reproduce and review proposal

proposed_fixes.title: Prevent Peek from disrupting Explorer selection

Correct the demonstrated interaction and add a regression scenario for Show in folder and direct Explorer selection.

reproduce.title: Prevent Peek from disrupting Explorer selection
prerequisites: A browser and a disposable downloaded file
steps: Use the browser's Show in folder and observe selection immediately and after a delay.
Repeat after Peek has run for several minutes, then with Peek disabled.
Repeat Open file location from Start and compare the reported Run action separately.
reproduce.expected_result: Explorer selects the target file and retains the selection with Peek enabled.
